Corollary
[norm zero implies flat]

Source: petersen:page-0431 ↗ prop:pet-ch11-norm-properties ↗ cor:pet-ch11-norm-bound-ball-containment 1. ch11:11.3.4If $\| (M,g,p)\| _{C^{m,\alpha },r}=0$ for some $r$, then $p$ has a flat neighborhood.
Proof

↗ cor:pet-ch11-norm-zero-implies-flat \sketch Norm zero gives an attained chart with $Q=0$ and, by the preceding corollary, a neighborhood containing $B(p,r)$. Its metric coefficients equal $\delta _{ij}$, so the chart is a local Euclidean isometry and the neighborhood is flat.

□
